notes: MODERN-RECREATION LABEL: the acquired clip is a modern 2021 retro-styled recreation, NOT genuine 1990s archive footage. Its set dressing (dark wood panelling, orange mushroom desk lamp, cream desk phone with coiled cord, parquet, leather-and-chrome chairs) reads more 1970s-80s than 1990s; only the beige CRT, desktop case and keyboard are plausibly early-1990s hardware. Do not caption or narrate it as archival, and do not attach a year to it.
